youtube.title: Old MacDonald Had a Farm 🐮 Animal Sounds Sing-Along for Toddlers | Toy Box Friends
youtube.description:
Sing Old MacDonald Had a Farm with Robo and learn animal sounds! Five animal friends are hiding on the farm: listen to the sound, guess who it is, count down 3, 2, 1, and see them jump out. Then sing each verse together, say the sound on your turn, and fill up the animal tracker. A big surprise is waiting in the barn at the end, then a quick point-to-it quiz.

Animals and sounds: cow (moo), duck (quack), pig (oink), sheep (baa), dog (woof) and horse (neigh).

Sing at home: make the sounds together, then ask "Who says moo?" and let your little one point or answer. Old MacDonald is a traditional public-domain rhyme.

Made for kids. Toy Box Friends: 3D learning videos for babies, toddlers and preschool.

do.text: Old MacDonald had a farm, E-I-E-I-O!
do.tune: G4 G4 G4 D4 E4 E4 D4:2 B4 B4 A4 A4 G4:2

do.text: Five animal friends are hiding! Can you find them?
And a BIG surprise is in the barn!
Listen! Who is hiding behind the hay?
I see two little horns! Who says moo?

do.tune: G4 G4 G4 D4 E4 E4 D4:2

do.text: And on that farm he had a cow,
With a moo moo here, and a moo moo there,
Here a moo, there a moo, everywhere a moo moo!
Old MacDonald had a farm, E-I-E-I-O!
do.tune: G4 G4 G4 D4 E4 E4 D4:2 B4 B4 A4 A4 G4:2

do.text: I see a yellow head! Who says quack?

do.tune: G4 G4 G4 D4 E4 E4 D4:2 B4 B4 A4 A4 G4:2

do.text: I see pink ears! Who says oink?

do.tune: G4 G4 G4 D4 E4 E4 D4:2

do.text: You found everyone! Now a quick game.

do.tune: G4 G4 G4 D4 E4 E4 D4:2 B4 B4 A4 A4 G4:2

do.text: Moo, quack, oink, baa, woof, and neigh!
Bye-bye, friends! See you on the farm!
